description.value: Steve's Poké Bar is an authentic Hawaiian poke chain founded by Steve Huynh, who grew up between Vancouver and Honolulu and draws on family recipes and local Hawaiian poké traditions. The Canada Place location places it steps from Vancouver's waterfront and convention centre, making it a convenient stop on a harbour cycling route. With over 10,000 five-star Google reviews and a menu spanning signature bowls, build-your-own options, and catering, it has become a well-established local institution.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active, multi-location Hawaiian poke chain with pick-up/delivery ordering clearly listed in navigation. The menu page lists a Shoyu Tofu bowl with avocado, confirming at least one vegetarian option. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant at a high-traffic Vancouver waterfront location. Website is live with current menu and promotions.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Shoyu Tofu bowl (7 pcs tofu with avocado, rice, and toppings), confirming at least one vegetarian option
